description: Default local coder models for NJ live benchmarks (~5–15 GB class), including Qwen, Mistral, DeepSeek, and Google Gemma.

models.title: Qwen 2.5 Coder 14B
models.notes: NJ historical specialist default; strong tool loops

models.title: Codestral 22B
models.notes: Mistral code model; NJ treats codestral as dedicated coder

models.title: Devstral 24B
models.notes: Mistral agentic coding model; needs ~32 GB RAM for comfort

models.title: Qwen 3.5 9B
models.notes: Fast modern baseline; also used as NJ utility/tool tier

models.title: CodeGemma 7B
models.notes: Google code-focused instruct model; fill-in-middle and codegen

models.title: Gemma 3 12B
models.notes: Google Gemma 3 mid-tier; strong reasoning and MBPP/HumanEval class
